cha.description: Force of personality, luck, and destiny. Drives dice luck and status effect potency.

size_index.description: Base size category (1=Tiny, 5=Gargantuan). Set by chassis blueprint.

natural_armor.description: Inherent protective integument (scales, shell, hide). Set by body covering components.

speed_bonus.description: Component-writable flat bonus fed into the Speed formula. Lets chassis and appendages affect speed without inflating dex.

sense_bonus.description: Component-writable flat bonus fed into the Perception formula. Lets sensory components affect awareness without inflating wis.

group_scale.description: World-spawn multiplier controlling pack or group size. Design-authored, not biologically derivable.

reputation.description: Social standing and fame. Changes through narrative events and player interactions.

cr.description: Designer-authored encounter balance value. Drives xp_value and loot_quality as derived outputs.

behavior.description: Current AI behavior state. Kept as a Raw stat so Effect Payloads can set and read it via the standard pipeline.

status.description: Current primary status condition. Kept as a Raw stat so Effect Payloads can set and read it via the standard pipeline.
